name: toc
title: Combo ToC
description: The jixoai Combo table of contents: desktop Rule Tracker (scroll-progress spine, weight-driven nodes on level-1, weight-driven text on flat level-2, pick + parent markers) and mobile Terminal Rail (glass single-row viewport with the 76px line law, expand changes ONLY height, scroll-snap list, tap = instant pick). DOM order: the aside precedes main content; desktop grid places it right, mobile sticky height:0 overlay.
